changelog: new (ONT-WGS, pipeline 1.1.0): comparison with type strains in the way TYGS and JSpeciesWS do it, from open tools. 16S copies are searched against NCBI RefSeq 16S (type material only — now also the default 16S reference for WGS, replacing Emu, which carried a mislabelled Klebsiella entry); type-strain genomes ('assembly from type material', one per species) of the candidate genera are downloaded from NCBI Datasets and cached; skani picks the closest 10; ANIb (1020-nt fragments, blastn, pyANI rules), ANIm (nucmer --mum) and TETRA are computed both ways; a verdict says known species / 95–96 % borderline / potential novel species. Trees: genome tree (FastME BioNJ+SPR on ANI distances) and 16S tree (MAFFT + IQ-TREE, ModelFinder, 1000 UFBoot), type strains marked T. Reference mapping: reads (minimap2) and the assembly (asm20) against the closest genome — breadth, depth plot, absent reference regions, isolate-specific regions, SNPs/indels and a synteny dot plot. The species shown is now the type-strain ANIb call (GTDB name kept beside it). New settings in Beta step 5 (type strains, ANIb/ANIm/TETRA, trees, mapping, keep BAM). dDDH is not computed (DSMZ GBDP is not distributed). Needs: bash ~/r16s-app/setup_wgs.sh (creates the ngamp-phylo env and the 16S database), backend restart, frontend build; then Re-analyse WGS jobs. Also: Beta console gets a PDF report button for amplicon runs (job page and results page; one run = full report, several = comparison, as in the production UI). Fix: a re-run (Re-analyse / Resume) no longer shows the previous run's finish time and a blank elapsed time while it runs. 16S: bracketed names such as '[Bacillus] caldolyticus' (genus known to be wrong) are no longer reported as a foreign genus.

previous.changelog: fix (ONT-WGS, pipeline 1.0.1): (1) 16S genus is now the majority genus of all reference names tied at the best identity, not the single top hit — a mislabelled 'Klebsiella pneumoniae' entry in emu_db_mar2026 that is 100 % identical to Acinetobacter 16S made OP-SCN1 read 'Klebsiella sp.'; minority-genus matches are listed as likely mislabelled entries. (2) 16S 'resolved' uses the full tie list per copy (the CSV column is cut at 8 names), so a copy tying ~30 B. cereus group species no longer yields one species. (3) Circular replicons < 1 Mb that MOB-suite calls 'chromosome' (Bacillus / Priestia megaplasmids) are reported as 'plasmid (putative)' instead of 'contig'; summary shows plasmids (+putative). (4) CheckM2 version no longer read from a TensorFlow timestamp. (5) Run notes list each general warning once. (6) GTDB / CheckM2 / Bakta databases downloaded into databases/wgs but not registered in db_paths.json are found and used automatically. Needs a backend restart; Re-analyse existing WGS jobs to apply.
